# The generated LVGL fonts (design 11). FIRMWARE ONLY.
#
# Generated by tools/gen-fonts.sh and committed, so an ordinary build
# needs neither node nor the DejaVu fonts. They sit in a component of
# their own because several screens draw with them and a per-component
# copy would cost the flash twice - see include/nn20clock_fonts.h.

if(NOT ESP_PLATFORM)
    return()
endif()

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "fonts/nn20clock_font_clock_220.c"
         "fonts/nn20clock_font_clock_140.c"
         "fonts/nn20clock_font_ui_bold_28.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES lvgl
)
